messages:
jo: Opening a small PR to update SDK snippets: streaming iterator shape, pagination token rename, and retry param rename. Will touch quickstart + migration guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4599

maya: Nice. Exact renames so I can patch the TS quickstart?

jo: Request: `page_token` -> `cursor_token`; responses now return `next_cursor`. Retry option `retry_policy` -> `retries` (shape: { attempts, backoff_ms? }). Streaming: Python/TS expose async iterators; Go uses a Next(ctx) loop.

leo: For Go snippet I'll show context cancel + io.EOF handling and defer Close. Keep quickstart compact and link full example for error/backpressure.

sam: I'll update TS and Py snippets. Suggested Py quickstart (compact):
```python
try:
    async for part in client.stream.generate(model="rwd-1-stream", prompt=prompt, retries={"attempts":2}):
        sys.stdout.write(part.text)
except StreamError:
    resp = client.sync.generate(model="rwd-1", prompt=prompt)
    print(resp.text)
```

maya: Add a one-liner after examples: "Streams may yield partial tokens; buffer if you need sentence-level output." Also mark quantized variants in model table that streaming latency can vary.

ci-bot: build/docs: linkcheck failed on `examples/pagination-old.md` -> 404. CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1588

sam: Fix pushed to change link to `examples/pagination-migration.md` and re-ran linkcheck.

ci-bot: build/docs: linkcheck passed.

jo: Thanks all  assigning reviewers @maya and @leo. Merge when +2 and green CI. :rocket:
